items.text: Stay here. Plain and simple. Just do it. This space is amazing. Comfortable, quiet, and cozy. Susan and David are very kind and responsive. The space is close to MANY restaurants and a short bike ride to the capitol. We walked even. Just amazing.

Highly recommended. The attention to detail is amazing - warm towels, platter, and beer on arrival along with homemade treats. Beautiful place with loads of sun and all the mod cons (free wifi a bonus) and easy walk to Ahuriri shops. Leanne herself is a great host - warm and friendly. Really enjoyed our stay here.

Beautiful place, great hosts (good communication and smooth check-in) and coordial housemates. The kitchen and bathroom were pretty clean and nice as well. There were only minor hiccups - the place had moisture smell when we entered (tho room was beautiful) and the area was local and friendly but didn’t feel like 10/10 safest at night.
A very clean and pleaseant  hotel. Very close to Taksim Square. Nice staff, very accommodating. Water and coffee provided every day. Serviced daily. A very nice stay there.

Great place. Kitchen had all the things to cook breakfast every morning. House was clean. Happy to have washer and dryer. Shower was nice and hot. Outdoor area was really cute and well manicured. Didn’t get to spend a whole lot of time outside considering it rained on us but definitely a cute space. Neighborhood was quiet. Beds where a little hard for our taste but we slept just fine. Coffee maker was delicious! Definitely used that. All in all definitely will return.

De accommodatie van Simon was een super thuisbasis tijdens onze reis in Rome. Een fijn en zeer ruim appartement met voldoende ruimte voor 4 personen. Naar Vaticaanstad is alles direct in de buurt. We hebben verder naar de stad ook alles belopen, maar hadden ook het openbaar vervoer kunnen pakken. Er zit een ingerichte keuken bij, maar direct bij het appartement ook een afhaal pizzeria, een gebakjes lunchroom en lunchroom/restaurant. Prijzen zijn daar ook zeer betaalbaar dus we hebben in het appartement niet gekookt. Alles was verder schoon en er ook al voldoende boodschapjes in huis om dagen door te komen. Thee, koffie, biertjes, water en koekjes. Dat was erg attent! Kortom: onze eerste ervaring met air bnb, maar door appartement van Simon meer dan bevallen!

We had an amazing time at the apartment. The location is great! :) There are coffee shops and bakeries all around the apartment. Additionally, the metro line is so close that the traveling around Barcelona is a non-issue. The apartment itself was neat, clean and included all the amenities one might need for a stay. Our host was just a message away at all times and we had a nice initial chat about tips and recommendations.

Meron is very sweet and a gracious host. Quiet time starts at 10pm but we were below the family that lives there and it sounds like people were running around all night. Very loud at night when going to bed. In the pictures it shows the same queen bed with different blankets which was confusing to me when I got there I thought there was 2 queen beds & 2 twin beds when in reality the picture was just posted twice. This is great place to stay to for a small family but no one older that has to use a cane or has a disability I would think it would be hard to get up and down the walk way. The space needs more privacy in front of that sliding door I had all girls there my sister was walking around in under clothes and shirt and a man came to clean the outside area and could see all in the house. I was not ok with that with all my girls being in the house. Definitely needs privacy curtains. With a little adjustment I would definitely stay again Meron is amazing very sweet and accommodating.

Great place! Excellent location in a lovely modern apartment that was clean and fresh. Close to shops, very close to Bilboa metro so great access to anywhere and plenty going on nearby. Loved the plush towels, roomy bathrooms and kitchen utensils and crockery.  Jorge was very responsive and helpful. There’s instructions in a kitchen cupboard for the major appliances.  We liked the place so much we’re staying in one very similar, managed by Jorge, for several weeks.  Note: if you’re arriving or leaving on a weekend, the nearest Main Street turns into a walking street so if you’re getting an Uber make the drop off/pickup the corner of Cardenal Cisneros & the apartment street. We had an Uber refuse to drop us off closer than a block and a half away with all our suitcases, but this street is much closer.

My stay started out in Waikiki, and as nice as the area can be, there was no way I was going to really enjoy the island with all of the noise and busy-ness of a city.. sure, Makaha is a good 50min drive from Waikiki area, but to say the ‘getaway’ is worth it is an understatement (!) and I was thankful EVERY time I left the cacophony of the city and got closer to the sound of the waves hitting the beach.  My condo stay was two months for work, it is ALL as advertised and if I could have stayed longer (b/c I was extended for another month) I would have in a heartbeat (I asked, but someone had already booked right after my stay ended)..  I appreciated the covered parking spot, basically the biggest lanai on the property -with grass- thoughtful, space saving amenities and I didn’t miss AC with the positive airflow in&out. Debi is awesome, super nice, very responsive (and quick) very informative/knowledgeable about the area, and even helped me find another really nice property in the area when I was too late to extend this one!

This is a real gem in Portland.  Very comfortable, adorable furnishings, super clean, huge and private and quiet, yet walking distance to restaurants, shopping, a Fresh Market where you can get everything you need.  The bed is wonderful.  The bath, laundry facilities, kitchen, tv, all excellent.  An excellent value for the location and the space.

I stayed 4 nights at Lissa’ s place. It was good, clean and cozy. Lissa was very nice and responsive. You will get everything you need for cooking. It’s close to street car station which led us to city in 10-15 mins. I would highly recommend this place:)

We really enjoyed our long weekend in Porto and the apartment was in a great spot. Quiet at night and an easy walk, well apart from the hilly nature of the city,  down to the river and you pass so many restaurants and bars. You dont have to rely on all the tourist bars as you will find many restaurants away form the river The street the apartment is on also has many places to eat, drink and some really good shopping. We used Uber to get around on a wet day and that is very reasonable. We were given a long list of places to eat and visit by the host which was very helpful. I  can't recommend this enough for a couple to explore this great city. If you have time also take a bot trip on the river, we used #douroboatman

Sergio our host & his kind friendly & accomodating family were charming. The went to great lengths too juggle our changed & delayed travels. This was sincerely enjoyable & appreciated.  A great comfortable disabled friendly apartment in a great location for exploring Catania & surrounding areas. The city is a busy hardworking 24 hour frenetic Sicilian metropolis........easier to adapt too, if you siesta & use quality earplugs!!!!! Air con was a blessing. Washer, well stocked basics in the apartment, WiFi, comfortably able to cook & eat at apartment. Great local shops, breakfast, gellato, Sicilian eve meals to be had. A well used by locals, Plaza to chill / read / play cards in, ...... people watch, have impromptu chats, make friends.  Sicilian people - young old in service to you or on metro ..... were always polite, friendly, welcoming, eager to befriend. Do brush up on basic Italian, they will try very hard to converse & love speaking English but it's not commonly spoken so basics will help you. It's very appreciated & a pleasure to try. Great local transport - Metro, Circumetnea for MT Etna, city buses, Ali Bus for to & from airport. Airport taxi 45 Euros, small tip,  most direc
Nice place, finished basement was very very cold.  Rest of the home was beautiful and close to a lot.
The apartment was great. It was very clean, spacious and close to all the actions in Porto. Our host gave us very helpful tips. I highly recommend the place.

A cozy well appointed airbnb. Centrally located so that you can walk anywhere.  The food is fantastic in the area with plenty of options.  Laundry is just down the street as well.  We loved every minute of our stay here!

Oscar was out of town so we never met him. We were met by his sister. the apartment is well fitted and comfortable and located in a very convenient area. Its on a noisy street. It was warm and leaving the windows open was loud in the morning. While we were there his mother open the door and let herself in this was awkward as I had to quickly put my shirt on. We had informed his mother we would be checking out between 10:30-11. But that morning we found out British Airways would not fly our dog home (although BA flew him here). We left a message for his mother we would be checking out about 30min later as we had to find other accommodations. The message was not relayed and around 11:15 a very nice man came by and was so supportive of our predicament. With all the stress of finding a new place to stay and deal with BA, it was nice to hear supportive words from someone. Luckily it was all sorted out and by 11:30 we were I our way to the hotel. And can fly home with our dog on Tuesday.

It really is next to a lot of what you need/want when traveling for both business and pleasure including - a 24 hr grocery store, a CVS, all kinds of restaurants/bars/coffee shops, many bus lines, and two train lines each within a 15 min walk. While you don’t really need to leave the neighborhood (AdMo) if you do want to it’s easy to get to downtown DC and other neighborhoods via public transit or taxis.  And yes it’s a busy neighborhood but at the same time this place is very private space since it’s a basement set up and on a quiet residential block (with lots of cute dogs!). Made it good for working when I needed to but also easy to pop out for fun and relaxing when done with work.  Lastly, appreciated that Shelly was timely with replying. I booked it a few days beforehand and she answered quickly.
This is a spacious unit in a good location. It is not the entire unit as advertised. The owner lives in the front of the house separated by a door with a 4 inch gap at the bottom.

This studio is one of the best AirBnB’s I’ve ever stayed at! The studio is just what my husband and I needed. There were small touches that made our stay even better: fresh fruit, French press and milk for coffee, a heating blanket for the bed if it was cold, even Tupperware to store our food! The studio was sparkling clean and exceeded our expectations. It’s a short walk to the beach. There was a bench overlooking the ocean, and we stayed up late to get a spectacular view of the stars. It was enchanting! In the morning, we walked along the beach with beautiful green waves crashing. Calm. Relaxing. We are definitely going to stay here again if we come back to NZ!

Absolutely amazing, cant fault it really. Ideal for first visits to thailand as we found everything nearby and a lot caters to tourists and english speakers. Amazing restaurant/bar down the road as well as café. Security at the complex were very helpful when we needed it. Other residents were lovely too. The apartment has everything you need, especially kitchenware.  One note is check the notices in the lobby as they had a fire alarm test during our stay.

I had a great time at Josephine‘s, hat a nice comfortable room, everyone was very friendly, helpful and respectful. Could even check in a bit early. Full use of bathroom and kitchen. The bathroom is upstairs but there is an extra toilet on the same level, which was very convenient. The wooden floor creaks a bit but it wasn‘t bothersome at all. Close to tube station North Clapham - the distance alone would be enough to stay at Josephine‘s again, but considering everything, it was great a stay. Totally worth it, very easy, relaxed, warm, comfortable. Would stay there again.

Nedjeljka’s place was just described! Lovely apartment that had everything we need for our stay, clean, comfortable and she was very helpful and quick to respond when I had a question :) thank you so much!

Jose’s place was wonderful. It was my first time ever using Air Bnb and first time ever visiting Spain. Jose was extremely helpful. He met my boyfriend and I at the apartment and showed us the best ways to get around town and where the best places to visit are. He provided maps and metro guides. He was also very responsive if we had to ask a question.  The  location is a 5 min walk from Camp Nou stadium and 5-10 minutes from the buses, tram, and metro. There is a grocery store within walking distance as well as many restaurants and delicious breakfast spots. VERY Clean! Thanks again Jose! My first Air Bnb experience was great =)

Thanks a lot, Carlo!  check-in and check-out were comfortable.  the timing could be coordinated with Carlo without any problem.  all accommodation matched the photographs.  it is convenient that there is a kitchen where you can prepare and store food.  next to a food store.  5 minutes walk.  the location is convenient, just 10 minutes from the railway station.  it is very convenient for travel.  every day I went to other cities by train.  the road is within 30 minutes and the price is up to 5 euros.  You can get from the airport by bus 16 for 1 euro or by train for 5 euros.  you need to get to the train station, and then walk 10 minutes to your destination.  google maps helped me a lot.  from the airport to the railway station by train in less than 30 minutes only.  by bus no more than 1 hour.  I advise everyone to stay with Carlo.  a great inexpensive option for travelers who walk all day and return in the evening to shower, dine and sleep.

I had an amazing stay with Karron and her cat, Pax. Her place is very easy to get to, and she let me arrive early so I could leave my bag. Her home is very cozy and comfortable. The drapery divider affords privacy when wanted. The bed is memory foam and felt amazing after a long day of walking. Karron was kind enough to create a list for me knowing I was looking to explore the neighborhood vintage shops. If you stay here, definitely explore the neighborhood, I loved it.  We were both busy but I enjoyed chatting with her- she is friendly and interesting. Pax, the cat, is sweet and somewhat shy. I would definitely want to stay here again next time I’m back in the area!
Awesome place not to far from the shops, great neighbourhood. Bus stop just down the road that leads you to the train station to get into the city.

A great comfortable extremely clean home to relax while in town or a quick get away. The Great kitchen and huge shower was a plus. Very close to major highways and great restaurants. Yoni was very prompt on answering my messages and very helpful whenever I reached out. Very attentive during the rain storm to assure my safety upon arrival. I'm looking forward to my next stay at this wonderful Airbnb. Thanks Yoni!!!

The apartment is in a quiet part of Rome with a view to die for. Everything you need is within easy reach. Bit of a walk up the hill after a long day sight seeing but that’s how you get the view! The meeting with the person who let me in was perfect, she showed me where everything was and had left a few basics which was really useful. The kitchen was amazingly well appointed and I lacked nothing while I was there. For the money I paid it was excellent value. Perhaps it could do with being decorated but it has loads of character. In short I think it was a brilliant place to stay and explore The glories of Rome and the Vatican

We were so delighted with our experience! Jeff and Kathi left clear instructions for check-in and check-out, and they followed up with us to be sure we arrived OK.  The accommodations were very clean and comfortable. Specifically, the bedding and mattresses were very comfortable.  We loved the location and appreciated the binder with recommendations for local restaurants and shopping. We travel to Dallas often for work, and we would definitely stay here again.

We arrived at 2AM in this beautiful little New Orleans neighborhood. Karen & Kelly were all ready for us, and we jumped in the bed faster than a wink, and slept like little children until breakfast by Chef Karen.  New Orleans was fantastic, but Karen's breakfasts were the high point of our day!  It felt like visiting favorite relatives - only better! Gourmet breakfasts, great advice on local activities, cheery greetings every morning and evening, and none of the usual problems with  relatives. What a dream!   We really connected on the food - Karen gave us her southern biscuit recipe, and told us all the best crawfish eating spots.  We loved this airbnb, but I hesitate to tell you because I want to make sure it's still available for us on our next visit!

Valery’s place is located in a great area in Paris (literally steps from the louvre). It was easy to get to all the museums and places we wanted from the metro. The place itself was on the 7th floor (Floor 6 technically, but be warned, it’s a workout). 3 of us stayed here, one on the couch and the other two barely fitting in the bed (due to the slanted wall - we knew this going in so was ok). The place had everything we needed including wine glasses :). Host was very nice, seems like a company so the person who met us was different than the person we talked to on airbnb. This along with a lack of communication was hard as we were unsure about how to check in/out however everything was ok in the end. Overall it was perfect for our stay in Paris and we had a trip of a lifetime. Thank you!

My husband Jeff and I can not express the level of relaxation and comfort we felt while at Maureen's.  She has created such a cozy yet professionally oriented space that is beyond compare. We awoke to the gorgeous view of the whitecapped waves in perfect sight. We had everything needed in the kitchen to create our favorite meals.  We enjoyed a very scenic day in Dingle and driving the Slea Head drive. Dinner downtown at a restaurant recommended by Maureen was fantastic. We strolled up to the "Fairie mound" with a bottle of champagne and snacks to watch an impeccable sunset. The beach was perfectly sandy at low tide and within walking distance. After having traveled most of Ireland, Dingle was a welcomed reprieve. We only hoped toward the end of our stay that we had booked more time.  We ended our visit with a lovely trail trek at Seaview Equestrian (another recommendation by Maureen). She did not save any local secrets-sharing her favorite spots, adventures, fellow businesses and day trips. Thank you for such a memorable Honeymoon, cheers!

The Villa Bellevue lives up to its name with its beautiful view - sitting atop a hill that looks out over two beaches, the main one at Agia Pelagia and the smaller Ligaria. The price you pay for the view is the walk back up from the beach - but it's worth it!   George has added steps and a path as a short-cut down to the Ligaria beach - it's obviously more effort coming back up, but absolutely manageable. When not feeling up to the walk, the pool is great. Good provision of sunbeds, shaded spots are available, lovely and clean.   The apartment was ideal, small kitchenette, beautifully decorated, and with the shutters we were able to keep it cool (early September, day temps between 26 and 30 celcius) during the days without needing to turn on the air conditioning at all. Breakfast was excellent! Factor the extra €6 in per person per morning, it's totally worth it, a great start to the day.   We hired a car as we took trips out most days. Our favourite was visiting Agios Nikolaos, then driving up the coast to Elounda and taking a boat trip to Spinalonga island fort. Having a car was also perfect for riding down to Agia Pelagia for evening meals - the Tavernas there were just right to

Der Kontakt zum Gastgeber war sehr freundlich und wir haben schnell eine Antwort auf Fragen erhalten. Wir waren von Mittwoch bis Sonntag in der Unterkunft. Leider ist diese so dermaßen hellhörig, dass man eher das Gefühl hat im Hausflur zu liegen. Aufgrund der Lautstärke haben wir an den Werktagen ab spätestens 6 Uhr überhaupt nicht mehr geschlafen. Dazu kommt, dass die Betten so weich sind, dass man in die Mitte rollt. Unsere Nächte waren daher nicht wirklich erholsam. Nebenan befindet im Übrigen eine Art Kindergarten. Im Badezimmer ist die Halterung von der Duschbrause nicht ganz funktionsfähig und im Wohnzimmer ist zwar ein TV vorhanden, dieser funktioniert aber nicht. Man kann sich lediglich bei TV Apps mit seinem eigenen Account anmelden und dann schauen.

This place is a diamond in the rough, the ability to have two king sized beds in Santiago is almost impossible. The staff at the apartments is extremely helpful, there’s even a pool we didn’t even know about! The supermercado is right across the street, you can walk to costanera, we had no problem getting Uber’s to pick us up from the other side of the street. I am so glad I stayed here and not somewhere else, they were amazing.

A very spacious 3 bedroom property in fantastic location. Beautifully clean, pristine white bed linen and bath towels. Furnished with everything you need at any time. Beautiful view. Enough space for 6 adults sharing. I can thoroughly recommend staying at this lovely property.

I've lived previously in Paris so know what I am looking for.  This is a fabulous apartment in the heart of Paris.  Metro just steps away.  Apartment is very quiet at night (and comfortable bed!), so you can get a good night's sleep.  Great kitchen, living room, and bathroom.  Plenty of room to spread out; lots of closet space.  Elodie is a fantastic host.  Great and fast communication before and during stay.  In short, with this apartment, it's all there.  I would definitely stay again!
Had a great stay at HiTop Studio for the few days in Asheville. Would definitely stay here again.  Details of the place were well thought out for all guests. Plus, who doesn’t love two shower heads?

The room and bathroom were clean and the bed is very comfortable. Clear entry instructions and quite neighborhood. Less than 10 minutes to the strip by car but it is a little out of the way for local restaurants and shopping if you're walking. The microwave, Keurig coffee maker and fridge in the room was welcome. I didn't meet either of the owners but communication was very fast via the Airbnb app. It was too cold to avail of the pool but I would definitely stay here again. Thanks

Mary and Theo were truly helpful and kind from the very beginning, and everything was as it looked like on the web, so there was no disappointment in any aspect. The place is a spotless clean, comfortable studio with almost everything you need, and the balcony with the beautiful view is an experience in itself!  Loved staying there and if I ever go back to Athens, I'll definitely would stay at Mary and Theo again! Truly recommended hosts and place! Thank you again!
Great place in Paris, everything in the apartment is exactly as described. We had plenty of room for 3 people. The Moroccan restaurant downstairs should be experienced

The hostess was very gracious and the location is wonderful. However, we were not informed that there was no elevator and we had to drag our baggage up three flights of steep steps. The apartment is shabby and the toilet /bathroom has no ventilation. The second bedroom is tiny and the bed is a plank of wood on wheels, with a very thin mattress. These minuses prevented us from having a perfect holiday experience, because when you're on holiday, part of the fun is coming back in the middle of the day for a little rest before the night time activities. We could not do it, because the thought of walking up those steps and sitting in a shabby apartment was not at all appealing. Furthermore, the building itself is in a state of disrepair and smells strongly of damp.
Great place for the weekend. Very comfortable with everything we needed ready to go. Excellent private location, very peaceful and made for a nice long weekend.

Hola , Soy Ivette , Mi hijo Antonello , estuvo con Bruno , Tuvo un excelente ,recibimiento, Bruno y su Esposa son excelentes anfitriones , y si !te sientes en casa , la habitacion muy bonita , y super bien ubicada a 20 minutos a pie del Duomo di Milano , pasando por lugares historicos de esta maravillosa ciudad , o si no te gusta caminar a 5 minutos el metro y a otros 5 minutos el Tram !  A quien no conoce Milano , les aconsejo muchisimo , rentar la habitacion de Bruno y sobre todo en esta parte de la ciudad.. Algo que me gusto ! efectivamente la habitacion esta como dice , la ubicacion esta muy cerca dil Duomo .Son personas muy amables y gentiles .... Salve ! Sono Ivette mio figlio Antonello e`stato con Bruno , sie sentito veramente in casa lo hanno accolto bennisimo, sono molto gentili , se vuoi avere una stanza carina in un posto meraviglioso a tan solo 20 minuti a piedi dil Duomo di Milano e a 5 minuti delle stazione della metro e il tram ..Vi consiglio veramente di stare da Bruno ... Noi presto torneremmo ...Saluti

Tessie was a lovely host and we had a really great time in Galway. The room is a comfortable one with a double- and a bunk bed (4 ps. in total) with an own sink in the room and a shared bathroom on the same floor. Everything was spotless. So when in Galway: Be sure to stay with Tessie.

Denise foi extremamente atenciosa e gentil em nossa estada, sempre com educação e respeito, muito generosa nos ajudou a achar locais diferentes para visitarmos, e é uma pessoa muito educada, deixamos um grande abraço... as comodacões correspondem a tudo o que há na propaganda, recomendamos a todos e voltaremos sempre...

The in-law apartment was clean and well appointed, with nearly all our needs anticipated. We felt very safe and comfortable. We would certainly recommend this unit to friends and family. The neighborhood was beautiful with fresh air and trees. It was very quiet, except, oddly enough, for wild turkeys. The turkeys woke us up daily at about 6 am with very high-pitched gobbles that did not remit, but were lessened by closing of the window. This was a first for us!
